:::{#exr-solve-score-equation}
#### Solving the score equation

Solve the score equation from @exr-score-equation for $\rate$, using the score from @exr-cyclone-score-fn.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-solve-score-equation}

$$
\begin{aligned}
0 &= \frac{n \bar x}{\rate} - n
&& \text{(score of the dataset)}\\
n &= \frac{n \bar x}{\rate}
&& \text{(add $n$ to both sides)}\\
n\rate &= n \bar x
&& \text{(multiply both sides by $\rate > 0$)}\\
\rate &= \bar x
&& \text{(divide both sides by $n$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::

Call this solution of the score equation $\tilde \rate$ for now:

$$\tilde \rate \eqdef \bar x$$
